gallery.title: BLADUS design system
gallery.intro: Every shared component of the kit, in all its states. Switch language to check French and Arabic (right to left).
gallery.typeSample: Stay where Algeria feels like home
gallery.bodySample: Riads in the Casbah, villas above Tipaza, camps under the Saharan sky, booked in dinars with verified local hosts.
gallery.eyebrowSample: Algeria, from the coast to the Tassili
gallery.coloursHint: Five hues only, every other colour is a tint, shade or alpha of these.
gallery.motionHint: Press Play to run each duration, easing or spring.
gallery.tryLoading: The first button runs loading, then morphs into a success check.
gallery.emailHelper: We'll send your booking confirmation here.
gallery.priceError: Enter a price of at least 1,000 DZD.
gallery.notePlaceholder: Tell Amina a little about your trip…
gallery.termsError: Please accept the house rules to continue.
gallery.instantDesc: Guests can book without waiting for your approval
gallery.flexibleDesc: Full refund up to 1 day before check-in
gallery.moderateDesc: Full refund up to 5 days before check-in
gallery.strictDesc: 50% refund up to 1 week before check-in
gallery.tabPanelUpcoming: Two stays coming up: Tipaza in May, Ghardaïa in June.
gallery.tabPanelPast: Five past trips across three wilayas.
gallery.faqCancelBody: With a flexible policy you get a full refund up to 24 hours before check-in. After that, the first night is kept by the host.
gallery.faqPayBody: You pay in dinars, at check-in or by CIB / Edahabia card. No card is needed to reserve.
gallery.faqHost: Can I message the host before booking?
gallery.faqHostBody: Yes. Every listing has a contact button, and most hosts reply within an hour.
gallery.dialogBody: You'll get a full refund because check-in is more than 24 hours away.
gallery.confirmBody: It disappears from search right away. Bookings already made are kept.
gallery.modalBody: The form modal used by login, sign-up, search and filters. On phones it becomes a bottom sheet.
gallery.toastError: We couldn't complete the booking. Please try again.
gallery.toastWarning: Only 2 nights left at this price.
gallery.bannerInfo: Only 12–14 May are free within your dates.
gallery.bannerSuccess: Your listing is live and visible in search.
gallery.bannerDanger: Your payout method has expired. Update it to keep receiving payments.
gallery.emptySearchDesc: Try other dates or remove a few filters.
gallery.emptyFavoritesDesc: Tap the heart on any listing to keep it here.
gallery.emptyMessagesDesc: When you contact a host, the conversation appears here.
gallery.emptyCalendarDesc: Plan your next trip across Algeria.
gallery.emptyGenericDesc: This space fills up as you use BLADUS.
gallery.celebrationDesc: Amina will message you before check-in in Tipaza.
gallery.topProgressHint: A thin terracotta bar runs at the top on every page change. Follow this link to see it.
